blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Bohol Gov. Erico Aristotle Aumentado expressed confidence that the province would return to a sustained growth path in the coming years, citing its strong economic fundamentals. During his State of the Province Address (Sopa) on Friday, Aumentado noted that the provincial economy grew by 3.9% in 2025, making it the second-fastest-growing economy in Central Visayas. Aumentado said Bohol ranked second among the region’s five economies, comprising two provinces and three highly urbanized cities, behind Cebu City but ahead of Cebu province.
